items.summary: Unauthenticated network attacker can compromise Oracle Access Manager's Authentication Engine via HTTP; scope-change allows full read/write/delete of critical data. Versions 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.2.1.0 affected; patch in Oracle's October 2026 CPU.

Easily exploitable unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite's Application Object Library (AppsTCFServer servlet) resulting in full takeover of the component. Versions 12.2.3–12.2.15 affected; patch in Oracle's October 2026 CPU.

A subset of Rank Math SEO PRO 3.0.123 packages downloaded Oct 15–16 shipped with embedded malware: self-restoring PHP backdoors, rogue admin accounts, and credential theft via an external C2. Sites that activated affected packages must treat themselves as compromised; 3.0.124 is the clean replacement.

In SuggestArr's local_bypass auth mode before 3.0.0, authentication trusts the spoofable X-Forwarded-For header — sending X-Forwarded-For: 127.0.0.1 grants unauthenticated admin sessions and full access to endpoints like /api/users and /api/jobs.

A missing critical step in Apache Tomcat's JNDIRealm authentication lets attackers log in without the correct password when a non-GSSAPI SASL mechanism is configured. Affects 11.0.0-M1–11.0.26, 10.1.0-M1–10.1.60, 9.0.0.M1–9.0.122; fixed in 11.0.27 / 10.1.61 / 9.0.123.
